description: The sovereign Jira/Confluence-killer of the estate, alongside zot (registry) and gitea-sovereign (source control). Work items, sprints and teams (the Jira side) and wiki pages (the Confluence side) are persisted as proof-carrying HellGraph facts in the project's proj- collection — the same collection Noetica and lattice-studio share — so every card and page is project/team-aligned, citable, preservable, curatable, and readable live by the agent team. Bridges Knowledge Engineering to the Knowledge Commons. Reuses Noetica's native work model (native = source of truth; Jira/Linear/GitHub Issues = optional external connectors only).

scaffold_baseline.status: PR-A scaffold — BFF over hellgraph-service; does not imply deployment readiness

agora_bff.description: FastAPI BFF (apps/agora) — /api/agora/{work,board,page,pages,team,''}. Stateless; will render charts/socioprophet-service via deploy/values/agora.yaml (pinned to the CI-published sha- tag) + a { name: agora } entry in deploy/argocd/platform-services.yaml. This PR builds the image only; the deploy wiring lands in a follow-up once the sha- tag exists (avoids the moving-:latest trap).

hellgraph_substrate.description: hellgraph-service is the system of record — work items / pages / teams are graph nodes + edges, NOT a side database.

identity_bindings.noetica_workspaces: Consumes Noetica's WorkItem/Sprint/Project model (lib/types/work.ts), moving it off localStorage onto the graph; cowork/workroom agents map to assignee/member edges.
identity_bindings.project_collection: proj_collection(project) === Noetica projectCollectionId — proj-<12hex>. Agora facts co-locate with the project KB.
identity_bindings.team_alignment: Teams are first-class nodes; work items align via in_team edges; boards scope by team.

commons_bridge.citable: Studio /api/studio/cite mints a sovereign PID + DataCite DOI over any work item or page.
commons_bridge.preservable: Studio /api/studio/preserve seals a tamper-evident version snapshot.
commons_bridge.curatable: Studio /api/studio/endorse + epistemic-weighted curation apply to work items and pages.

pr_a_status.note: PR-A introduces the BFF + estate registration. Does NOT imply deployment readiness. First CI build publishes a sha- image tag; gitops-promote pins deploy/values/agora.yaml before it goes live.

runtime_prerequisites.description: agora-write-token Secret must exist in namespace socioprophet before writes are accepted (fail-closed until then).
deploy/values/agora.yaml image.tag must be pinned to the CI-published sha- tag (not a moving :latest) before rollout.

authority_boundary.note: prophet-platform owns the runtime deployment and API contract; Noetica owns the client-side work UX and is the upstream of the WorkItem/Sprint/Project model.
